tool.name: Climate to STICS Format
tool.description: Transforms climate data (ERA5, SAFRAN/GeoSAS, DRIAS-2020 or custom) into STICS crop model daily input files
tool.command:
python '$__tool_directory__/climate_to_stics.py'
## --- Source type --- --source_type '$data_source.source_type'
## --- Input files --- #if $data_source.source_type == 'drias': --drias_zip '$data_source.drias_zip' #else: --input_file '$data_source.input_file' --input_format '${data_source.input_file.ext}' #end if
## --- Spatial --- --epsg '$spatial.epsg' #if $spatial.shapefile_zip: --shapefile_zip '$spatial.shapefile_zip' #end if #if $spatial.cell_id_column: --cell_id_column '$spatial.cell_id_column' #end if
## --- CO2 --- ## CO2 concentrations are retrieved automatically by the script ## (Mauna Loa online + ice cores before 1959): no file required.
## --- Advanced --- --wind_correction_factor '$advanced.wind_correction_factor' #if $advanced.custom_var_mapping: --custom_var_mapping '$advanced.custom_var_mapping' #end if
## --- Output --- --output_zip '$output_zip' --log_file '$log_output'

param.name: source_type
param.label: Climate data source
param.help: Determines the variable mapping and unit conversions applied automatically.

param.name: input_file
param.label: ERA5 file
param.help: NetCDF (or tabular) file containing daily ERA5 variables. Expected variables: mx2t / mn2t (temperatures), ssrd (radiation), tp (precipitation), pev (ETP), si10 / u10+v10 (wind), d2m (dew point). The data must be at a daily time step (accumulated over 24 h).

param.name: input_file
param.label: SAFRAN / GeoSAS file
param.help: File produced by the GeoSAS extraction tool. Expected variables: Tmax, Tmin (°C), RR (mm), ETP (mm), Rg (MJ/m²/day), FF (m/s), HU (%). A cell identifier (column 'cell' or equivalent) is required if the file is tabular (no shapefile rasterisation).

param.name: drias_zip
param.label: ZIP archive of DRIAS-2020 NetCDF files
param.help: ZIP archive containing the DRIAS NetCDF files (one file per variable). Expected names: *tasmax*.nc, *tasmin*.nc, *huss*.nc, *sfcWind*.nc, *rsds*.nc, *prtot*.nc, *evspsblpot*.nc. Variables in K (temperatures), kg/m²/s (precip., ETP), W/m² (radiation).

param.name: epsg
param.label: Input data projection (EPSG code)
param.help: E.g.: EPSG:4326 (WGS84), EPSG:2154 (RGF93/Lambert-93), EPSG:27572 (extended Lambert II).

param.name: shapefile_zip
param.label: Spatial cells shapefile (ZIP archive)
param.help: ZIP archive containing the shapefile (.shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj). Required for gridded (NetCDF) data without a cell ID column. The shapefile must have a 'cell' column with the numeric ID of each cell.

param.name: cell_id_column
param.label: Cell ID column name (tabular data)
param.help: For CSV / TSV / Parquet / JSON files that already contain the cell ID. Default: 'cell'. Not used when a shapefile is provided.

param.name: wind_correction_factor
param.label: Wind height correction factor
param.help: Converts wind speed to 2 m height (STICS reference) from the measurement height (10 m for ERA5/DRIAS/SAFRAN). Standard logarithmic profile: 0.7 ≈ ln(2/0.03)/ln(10/0.03). Set to 1.0 to disable the correction.

param.name: custom_var_mapping
param.label: Custom variable mapping (JSON)
param.help: JSON object mapping the internal STICS name to the variable name in the source file. Valid keys: tasmax, tasmin, wind, rsds, prtot, etp, hr, vapp, huss, d2m, u10, v10. Example: {"tasmax": "T_max", "prtot": "PRECIP", "wind": "FF_10m"} This mapping overrides the predefined mappings (ERA5, SAFRAN, DRIAS).

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**Climate to STICS Format** converts daily climate data from ERA5, SAFRAN/GeoSAS or DRIAS-2020 into input files compatible with the **STICS** crop model (multidisciplinary simulator for standard crops).
-----
**What this tool does** ========================
1. **Loads** climate data in various formats (NetCDF, CSV, TSV, JSON, Parquet). 2. **Renames and converts** variables according to their source (ERA5, SAFRAN, DRIAS or custom JSON mapping). 3. **Computes derived variables** not present in the source (mean temperature, relative humidity, vapour pressure). 4. **Assigns each pixel/row** to a spatial cell ID (via a shapefile or an existing column). 5. **Automatically retrieves and merges** annual CO2 concentrations (NOAA/GML Mauna Loa series downloaded online for 1959 onward, complemented by ice-core values for earlier years). 6. **Exports** a ZIP archive containing one directory per cell and one file per year, in the headerless TSV format expected by STICS.
-----
**STICS output format** ========================
Each file ``{cell_id}.{year}`` is a headerless TSV with columns in this exact order:
.. list-table:: :header-rows: 1 :widths: 20 20 60
* - Column - Unit - Description * - Cell ID - – - Integer ID of the spatial cell * - Year - – - Calendar year * - Month - – - Month (1–12) * - Day of month - – - Day within the month (1–31) * - Day of year - – - Julian day (1–365/366) * - tasmin - °C - Daily minimum temperature * - tasmax - °C - Daily maximum temperature * - rsds - MJ/m²/day - Global solar radiation * - etp - mm/day - Potential evapotranspiration * - prtot - mm/day - Total precipitation * - wind - m/s - Wind speed at 2 m * - vapp - hPa - Air vapour pressure * - co2 - ppm - Atmospheric CO2 concentration
-----
**Variable mapping by source** ===============================
ERA5 (Copernicus) ------------------
.. list-table:: :header-rows: 1 :widths: 25 30 25 20
* - STICS variable - ERA5 name - Input unit - Conversion * - tasmax - ``mx2t`` / ``mx2t24`` - K - − 273.15 * - tasmin - ``mn2t`` / ``mn2t24`` - K - − 273.15 * - rsds - ``ssrd`` - J/m² (daily accumulation) - ÷ 10⁶ * - prtot - ``tp`` - m/day - × 1000 * - etp - ``pev`` / ``e`` - m/day (often negative) - absolute value × 1000 * - wind - ``si10`` or ``u10``+``v10`` - m/s (10 m) - × height factor * - vapp - computed from ``d2m`` - K - August–Roche–Magnus
.. note:: For ``u10`` + ``v10``, the resulting speed is computed as: ``wind = √(u10² + v10²) × factor``. Vapour pressure is derived from the dew point ``d2m`` (August–Roche–Magnus formula).
SAFRAN / GeoSAS (Météo-France) --------------------------------
.. list-table:: :header-rows: 1 :widths: 25 30 25 20
* - STICS variable - GeoSAS name - Input unit - Conversion * - tasmax - ``Tmax`` / ``T_max`` - °C - none * - tasmin - ``Tmin`` / ``T_min`` - °C - none * - rsds - ``Rg`` / ``GLO`` - MJ/m²/day - none * - prtot - ``RR`` / ``Precip`` - mm/day - none * - etp - ``ETP`` - mm/day - none * - wind - ``FF`` / ``Vent`` - m/s (10 m) - × height factor * - hr - ``HU`` / ``Hrel`` - % - none * - vapp - computed from ``HU`` + ``Tmean`` - – - Tetens
DRIAS-2020 (CMIP5/6, climate projections) -------------------------------------------
DRIAS NetCDF files contain one variable per file. The tool detects them automatically from the file name pattern (``*tasmax*.nc``, etc.).
.. list-table:: :header-rows: 1 :widths: 25 30 25 20
* - STICS variable - DRIAS name - Input unit - Conversion * - tasmax - ``tasmaxAdjust`` - K - − 273.15 * - tasmin - ``tasminAdjust`` - K - − 273.15 * - rsds - ``rsdsAdjust`` - W/m² - × 86400 ÷ 10⁶ * - prtot - ``prtotAdjust`` - kg/m²/s - × 86400 * - etp - ``evspsblpotAdjust`` - kg/m²/s - × 86400 * - wind - ``sfcWindAdjust`` - m/s (10 m) - × height factor * - huss → hr → vapp - ``hussAdjust`` - kg/kg - psat + Tetens formula
-----
**CO2 concentrations (automatic)** ====================================
Annual CO2 concentrations no longer need to be **supplied**: the tool builds the table itself, from two combined sources:
- **1959 → present**: Mauna Loa annual mean, downloaded online from NOAA/GML (``co2_annmean_mlo.txt``). The most recent value available is therefore used automatically on every run. - **before 1959**: ice-core record adjusted to the global mean (NASA/GISS, after Etheridge et al. 1996), bundled with the script.
The CO2 value (ppm) is added as the last column of each STICS file.
.. note:: Downloading the Mauna Loa series requires network access to ``gml.noaa.gov`` at run time. If unavailable, the tool automatically falls back to a bundled snapshot (1959-2023) and reports this in the log.
-----
**Cell shapefile** ====================
The ZIP archive must contain the standard shapefile components: ``.shp``, ``.shx``, ``.dbf``, ``.prj`` (and optionally ``.cpg``). The shapefile must have a ``cell`` column with the integer ID of each cell.
For **tabular** data (CSV/TSV/Parquet/JSON) that already contains a cell ID column, the shapefile is not needed — simply give the column name in "Spatial parameters".
-----
**Custom mapping (JSON)** ============================
For a non-predefined source, provide a JSON object in the advanced text field::
{ "tasmax": "T_max_2m", "tasmin": "T_min_2m", "prtot": "PRECIP_TOTAL", "rsds": "RAY_GLOB", "etp": "EVAP_POT", "wind": "VENT_MOY", "hr": "HUMID_REL" }
This mapping **overrides** (and extends) the predefined mappings for the selected source.
-----
**Workflow integration** ==========================
This tool is designed to chain with:
- **ERA5 Daily Extractor** (Galaxy CDS tool) → ``input_file`` (NetCDF, ERA5 source) - **GeoSAS SAFRAN Extractor** → ``input_file`` (CSV or NetCDF, SAFRAN source) - **STICS Runner** → consumes the produced ZIP archive
